content:
https://github.com/lukewilliamboswell/roc-pdf/releases/tag/0.1.0-rc3

This is a really big lift in the capabilities of the package -- you should be able to make useful PDF's. There are some limitations and features still on the roadmap. Checkout the examples on the front page for a quick demo of what it can do now.

I haven't worked on this for a few weeks, I have been waiting for bug fixes to land in a nightly and working on other things. I'll probably get back to the roadmap soon.

I'm leaving this as a RC for now -- I'd like to replace my PDF generation pipeline for all my repo docs/manuals before I am happy this is good for a 0.1 and to share more broadly.

Please let me know if you try it out, both good an bad experiences are helpful for me to improve it.
There is also heaps of scaffolding and things lying around... it's a bit messy in some places if you go digging.
